subject: Tiered acceptance windows & legal handoff — MAP for MSA/DPA/order form
messages:
From: Maya Rao <maya.rao@clearlabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procureops@clearlabs.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: acceptance cadence and legal sequencing

Hi Vivek / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs were impressed with the latency profile and the routing/fallback approach. Procurement asked me to put together a short MAP so we can lock the procurement window and legal sequencing. Attached is our working MAP draft (clear-corp-map-draft-v2.xlsx).

High-level asks from ClearLabs:
- We need MSA + DPA signed before purchase order (PO) is issued.
- Security review (brief) needs to finish before DPA sign-off; that review team needs two weeks to validate audit logs and KMS integration notes.
- Procurement prefers the order form signature to be the final commit (PO issuance within 3 business days of order form).

Proposed MAP structure (quick):
1) Week 1: Legal intake (MSA redlines + DPA initial review)
2) Week 2-3: Security verification (SOC2 artifacts, KMS notes)
3) Week 4: Final legal sign-off and order form execution

Can you confirm if Redwood needs any additional gating (e.g., SSO proof-of-concept) that would shift these windows? Also recommend a single point of contact on the Redwood side for legal queries and for procurement.

Attachments: clear-corp-map-draft-v2.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

Cheers,
Maya Rao
Head of Procurement
ClearLabs

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya.rao@clearlabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: acceptance cadence and legal sequencing

Thanks Maya — this looks like a good starting point. A few clarifying notes from our side:

- Point of contact: I'll own procurement cadence and initial SLAs. Laura (legal) will own contract redlines and DPA specifics. Karthik will surface any model/ops-related gating. Jasmine (CS) will drive acceptance criteria and run the pilot checklist with your SRE team.

- Suggested adjustment to sequencing:
  • Week 1: Legal intake (MSA redlines + DPA initial pass) — redwood returns redlines within 3 business days of receipt.
  • Week 2: Security artifacts & narrow POC (KV cache behavior + prefix caching) — engineering verification (3 business days).
  • Week 3: Legal finalization + procurement signoff. Order form executed and PO issued within 48–72 hours.

Rationale: our experience is that running security validation and legal redline cycles in parallel (with a sync at the end of Week 2) shortens calendar risk. If ClearLabs needs DPA to be 100% complete before any engineering work, add +1 week buffer.

Action items I can own now:
- Schedule a 30-minute legal/procurement sync (suggest Aug 17 or 18)
- Share Redwood's MSA redline template and DPA checklist (attaching redwood-msadpa-dependency-diagram.pdf for the dependency map)

Attachment: redwood-msadpa-dependency-diagram.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

Are you available Aug 17 at 10am PT for the sync?

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rao <maya.rao@clearlabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: acceptance cadence and legal sequencing

Quick legal perspective following our intake sync today. Thanks for the clear draft, Maya. A few constraints and gating conditions to bake into the MAP:

- DPA scope: we need to confirm the data flows and whether ClearLabs will host any inference traffic within their VPC (private deployment). If data remains on Redwood-hosted inference, DPA review is simpler; if VPC/on-prem, add additional security annex (2 week review).
- Change control for order forms: Redwood standard practice is to treat the order form as the commercial commitment; any material changes after signature require a change notice and re-approval from finance. Please confirm if ClearLabs anticipates phased rollouts which might alter the order form scope.
- SLA carve-outs: If you require SLA credits tied to tail latency beyond 99th percentile, that needs specific language in the MSA and will add another legal iteration (estimate +3 business days).

Suggested MAP updates (we'll update the spreadsheet):
- Add a gating row: "DPA Annex required if VPC/on-prem" with conditional two-week review.
- Add explicit milestone: "Order form signed -> PO out within 72 hours" with procurement contact listed.
- Add legal hold for SLA extractions if requested (modeled as separate addendum).

I've uploaded the dependency diagram Vivek referenced and will share our MSA redline template in the next email thread.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Maya Rao <maya.rao@clearlabs.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procureops@clearlabs.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: acceptance cadence and legal sequencing

Hi Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the updates and the diagram. Procurement confirms we can operate to the compressed timeline if the following holds:
- Redwood returns MSA redlines within 3 business days of receipt (we will provide initial redlines within 48 hours)
- Security artifacts (SOC2 report + key management notes) provided by Redwood team on Aug 19 for our security review; security completes on Aug 31 at latest
- If Redwood flags a DPA Annex (for VPC/on-prem), we will accept the 2-week conditional review, but we need a final decision by Aug 27 to keep the PO timing intact

Next steps we need from Redwood by EOD Aug 27:
- Finalized MAP workbook (incorporating the gating rows)
- MSA redline (first pass)
- Confirmation of the procurement contact and PO timing (ProcureOps will be the issuer)

ProcureOps contact: procureops@clearlabs.com

If you can deliver these by EOD Aug 27 we will target order form signature and PO issuance in the first week of September.

Best,
Maya Rao
Head of Procurement, ClearLabs

Attachments referenced earlier: clear-corp-map-draft-v2.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-msadpa-dependency-diagram.pdf (PDF)
